name: trial
description: Calibration run (coding plan section 8): probe pass for all 30 algorithms and operations (freezes fast/slow and feeds the runtime estimate); E10 for the three ML-DSA sets with 5 repetitions (A/A noise floor); E1 with 5 repetitions for ML-DSA-44, ML-KEM-768, Ed25519 and X25519 and Falcon-512 sign/verify, and 3 repetitions for SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f and HQC-1 (drift limit); canary every 5 minutes (canary limit). Approved budgets.
